tools.name: generate_captions
tools.description:
Use when the user wants ready-to-post social captions — hooks, post
    bodies, CTAs, and hashtags as JSON for LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, or X.

    Deterministic template engine (no LLM): best for on-brand, repeatable
    captions, not open-ended creative writing.

    tone: warm | bold | profess

tools.name: check_balance
tools.description:
Use before generating when you're unsure the key still has credits,
    or when the user asks about their plan, tier, or expiry.

    Shows remaining API credits, key tier, and expiry.

tools.name: mint_free_trial
tools.description:
Use when no API key is configured and the user wants to try
    Caption-Pack free. Only call after the user agrees to the free tier —
    never mint silently.

    Mints a 25-call trial API key (no card, no account).
    Abuse guards: one key per IP per day, 7-day expiry, free keys can never
    con

findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "mint_free_trial" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.

evidence.snippet: Use when no API key is configured and the user wants to try Caption-Pack free. Only call after the user agrees to the free tier — never mint silently. Mints a 2…

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "mint_free_trial" references sensitive artifacts (api_key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "mint_free_trial" stacks urgency/override words (immediately, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: generate_captions · Private data: mint_free_trial · Public sink: generate_captions.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: generate_captions · Private data: mint_free_trial · Public sink: generate_captions

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
